title: RNA Extraction from Sterivex Filters and cDNA Library Generation
author: Paraskevi (VIvian) Mara
materials: For Sterivex filters, follow steps A2–A3.
For Sterivex samples, follow steps A7–A9.
For Sterivex samples, follow steps A10–A11.

steps.title: Prepare Sterivex Filters
steps.instruction: Thaw Sterivex filters on ice and remove any residual liquid or RNAlater using a 3 mL syringe.

steps.title: Seal Sterivex Filter
steps.instruction: Seal the lower end (nipple) and the lower rim of each Sterivex filter with parafilm or Sterivex caps to prevent leakage.

steps.title: Add Beads to Sterivex
steps.instruction: Add beads (from manufacturer 5 mL kit tubes or UV-sterilized beads) to approximately 1/10 of the Sterivex filter volume.

steps.title: Prepare and Add PM1 Buffer
steps.instruction: Heat 1.8 mL aliquots of PM1 buffer in 2 mL Eppendorf tubes at 65 °C for 5 min, then transfer the heated buffer into each Sterivex using a clean 3 mL syringe fitted with a 22G needle.

steps.title: Add 2-mercaptoethanol
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of molecular-grade 2-mercaptoethanol using a 1 mL syringe fitted with a 22G needle.

steps.title: Lyse Sterivex Sample
steps.instruction: Seal the upper end of the Sterivex with parafilm and vortex to ensure bead contact with the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Vortex at maximum speed for ~2 min.
Invert the Sterivex 180° and vortex again for ~2 min.

steps.title: Recover Lysate from Sterivex
steps.instruction: Use a 3 mL syringe to push air into the upper end of the Sterivex filter to recover the lysate into 2 mL tubes. Repeat until the Sterivex is fully drained.

steps.title: Extract RNA from Sterivex Lysate
steps.instruction: Process the recovered lysate following the manufacturer's protocol.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,100 × g for 1 min.
Transfer supernatant to a clean 2 mL tube and continue extraction per manufacturer's protocol.
Elute total RNA in 30–40 µL of RNase-free water.

steps.title: Prepare Alternative Filters (GFF/Membrane)
steps.instruction: Prepare UV-sterilized 15 mL Falcon tubes with UV-sterilized beads and process GFF, 2.7 µm, or 0.2 µm filters.

substeps.instruction: Remove filters from storage using sterile pipette tips and place in RNA-cleaned, UV-sterilized glass Petri dishes.
Cut filters into small pieces using sterile scalpel blades and transfer to Falcon tubes using the scalpel tip or sterile 100 µL pipette tips.

steps.title: Lyse Alternative Filters
steps.instruction: Add lysis reagents and vortex the samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.8 mL Lysis/Binding Solution (kit reagent) into the 15 mL Falcon tubes (for GFF/membrane) or into the Sterivex using a syringe.
Add 100 µL β-mercaptoethanol (Sigma-Aldrich, BioUltra ≥99%) using a 1 mL syringe fitted with a 22G needle.
Vortex Falcon tubes for 5 min.

steps.title: Process Alternative Filter Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge and treat the lysate for RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 15 mL Falcon tubes at 3,000 × g for 5 min (RT).
Transfer supernatant to 2 mL tubes and add 190 µL miRNA Homogenate Additive; incubate on ice for 10 min.
Centrifuge at 13,100 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Perform Acid-Phenol:Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract RNA using Acid-Phenol:Chloroform and ethanol precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Transfer supernatant to 15 mL tubes and perform Acid-Phenol:Chloroform extraction (1:1 volume) per manufacturer protocol.
Centrifuge at RT for 5 min (repeat if phase separation is not clear).
Transfer aqueous phase to new tubes and add 1.25 volumes of 100% Ethanol; mix by gentle inversion.
Pass 600 µL of the lysate/ethanol mixture through the manufacturer's filter cartridge, repeating until the sample is processed.
Complete remaining steps according to the mirVana protocol.
Elute total RNA in 30 µL elution buffer.

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove DNA contamination from the eluted RNA.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 20–30 µL RNA into PCR tubes.
Add nuclease-free water (12.5–22.5 µL depending on RNA volume).
Add 5 µL DNase buffer and 2.5 µL DNase I.
Incubate at 37 °C for 20 min, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Clean up DNase-treated RNA
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA after DNase treatment.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL RNase-free water to each 50 µL DNase-treated RNA reaction.
Elute in 30 µL.
Use a 1:1 ratio of RNA beads to RNA (RNAClean XP Bead-Based Reagent per NEBNext Ultra II protocol).

steps.title: Verify DNA Removal
steps.instruction: Verify the absence of DNA contamination using PCR reactions with 16S primers prior to library preparation.

steps.title: Generate cDNA Library (Watchmaker)
steps.instruction: Follow the Watchmaker Total RNA Library Prep Kit protocol with xGen™ Stubby Adapters (IDT) using these modifications:

substeps.instruction: Fragmentation time: 3–6 min (use 3 min if RNA is already partially fragmented).
Adapter concentration: 0.1 µM (from 15 µM stock) for low biomass or low-water volume samples (up to 1 L).

steps.title: Generate cDNA Library (NEBNext)
steps.instruction: Follow the NEBNext® Ultra™ II RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina (poly(A) mRNA or total RNA) protocol.

substeps.instruction: For low-biomass or low filtered-water-volume samples (up to 1 L), use a higher adaptor dilution (>100-fold in Adaptor Dilution Buffer).
